test_cases.what_to_try: On the empty new chat, press the speech-bubble button at the top right once and look at what changed on the screen. Press it again and look again. Then press 'Create an image or sticker' and press the same button while it looks grey. Finish with the button back in its first look.
test_cases.real_if: after pressing each look you still cannot tell what it did, what state you are in, or whether the grey one does anything
test_cases.not_real_if: after pressing, the screen tells you plainly what each look means, and you could tell the plain, ticked and grey looks apart as one switch
test_cases.what_happened: On the empty chat I pressed the broken speech bubble at the top right. The middle of the screen changed to a heading, "Temporary chat - This chat won't appear in history", the button got a tick inside it, and the typing box said "Temporary chat". So the ticked look plainly means I am in a temporary chat. I pressed it again: the tick went away, and for a moment the heading still said "Temporary chat" with "Unpersonalized" under it, which confused me, but a second later the normal empty chat came back with "Ask ChatGPT" in the box. Then I pressed "Create an image or sticker" and pressed the faint grey bubble. It did not change anything, but a dark note appeared beside it saying this model does not support temporary chat, and that I should start a new chat or pick a different model. That told me the grey look means the switch is unavailable here, although "model" is a word I had to think about. The note stayed over the X until I tapped elsewhere. The button ended in its first plain look. I could finish.

test_cases.what_happened: From the plus menu I pressed "Photos": the phone's photo picker slid up, with "Photos" and "Albums" tabs and "No photos yet". The phone's Back button took me straight back to the chat. Then I opened the Stickers page. The sentence read "Create a 3D sticker pack based on Photo, remixing with" and some emoji, with "3D" and "Photo" in faint outlined bubbles, and the keyboard was open. I pressed "Photo": a small menu appeared with "Take photo" and "Choose photo". I pressed "Choose photo" and got the same photo picker as before. Back returned me to the sentence, and the X at the top left closed the sticker page back to the image styles. Before pressing I would not have known that the word "Photo" in the sentence was a button that leads to choosing a photo. Once pressed, though, it clearly offered the same choices and took me to the same place as "Photos".
